item.tib: gsas mkhar rab 'byams rtsa gsum kun 'dus las me dpung rab 'bar sbyin sreg kyi mchong
item.coloph: bdag 'dra snyigs ma'i sngags 'chang dbal 'bar stag slag can gyis / lho phyogs rgyal mo tsha ba rong / gnas mchog bkra shis spungs pa'i ri bo nas gter las spyan drangs te/ dbyibs klong lhun po brtsegs pa'i dgon du shog ser bod yig tu bsgyur ba dge'o//
